notes.title: 📢 Calling all VR 🥽 gamers who love IIWWW history of their grandmas! 🎮
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/376bf68fa2bd1373804d153559ca20c2b16d1c80.jpg[/img]

We need your support! We are excited to announce that our game, [b]"Siberian Run VR"[/b] can be nominated for the prestigious Labor of Love category on Steam! We believe that our game deserves this recognition because it was crafted with love and passion, setting it apart from the rest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/21640d351e58f9ed5a648615dc54cbdd852240a1.png[/img]

At its core, [b]"Siberian Run VR"[/b] is not just another VR game. It is a testament to the strength of the human spirit and a homage to the untold stories of our loved ones. The game director drew inspiration from his own grandmother's harrowing experience in Siberian prisons during a time of Russian aggression in Ukraine. As a tribute to her, we even included an actual letter she wrote to her mother from her imprisonment.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/f6d3171377a8041cb908894f9f8815667e2326a3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/97bad7bd02439e31857bf7ea66fe5195aa51f4ba.png[/img]

We invite you, our amazing community of players, to show your support by voting for "Siberian Run VR" in the Labor of Love category. Your votes will help shed light on the importance of narratives that resonate with us on a personal level. By honoring our game's dedication and emotional depth, together we can make a difference.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/6bf4e965b5d9b0132c61d7217ec830ca00dfbac2.png[/img]

To cast your vote, simply visit our Steam page and click on the "Vote" button located at the top of the page. Let us rally together and showcase the power of a labor of love in the gaming world!

Thank you, gamers, for your continued support and for recognizing the efforts we put into creating "Siberian Run VR"

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34993362/376bf68fa2bd1373804d153559ca20c2b16d1c80.jpg[/img]
